observations: Photo 0: A black rechargeable standing fan, five-blade design, control panel with buttons and a small display on the motor head, photographed indoors against a wall with a visible electrical outlet.
Photo 1: Same fan from a different angle, showing the blade guard, charging cable dangling from the base, and a watermark/logo overlay partially obscuring text on the motor hub.
No clear legible brand or model text visible on the fan in either photo; the hub text is blurred and covered by a watermark reading 'STORE'.
No photo of the remote control, charger/adapter, or battery indicator in use.
No video or evidence showing the fan actually running or holding charge.

claims.evidence: No clear brand text legible in photo 0 or photo 1; the hub markings are blurred and obscured by a watermark.
Photo 1 shows visible wear, scuffing, and a loose charging cable consistent with prior use.

claims.claim: Lasts up to 2 hours when fully charged, longer on low
claims.evidence: No video or runtime demonstration provided; battery performance cannot be judged from static photos.

risks.risk: Battery health/runtime may be degraded or far below claimed 2 hours.
risks.proof: A timed video clip showing the fan running unplugged from empty to full charge or a timestamped runtime test.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having significantly reduced battery life

risks.risk: Motor or blade function may be faulty (seller only shows static photos).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the fan powered on and oscillating/spinning at different speeds.

risks.risk: Remote control or charger adapter may be missing, which affects usability and resale value.
risks.proof: A photo of the remote control and the charging adapter/cable together with the fan.

risks.risk: Unreadable brand text could mean it is a generic or rebranded fan rather than genuine Qasa, affecting value.
risks.proof: A close-up, well-lit photo of the hub/nameplate showing brand and model clearly.

proof_requests: Short video of the fan running on battery power (unplugged) showing oscillation and speed settings.
Close-up photo of the brand/model plate on the motor hub, unobstructed by watermark.
Photo of the remote control and charging adapter included with the sale.
A timestamped runtime test showing how long the fan runs fully charged.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used rechargeable standing fan, but brand/model cannot be confirmed from the photos and all functional claims (runtime, battery health, working motor) are unverified, so it must be priced at worst case against comparable rechargeable standing fans.
